instruction: Cross-tab summary across row and column dimensions.

dimensions.names: provide dimension names separated by comma, min 2 max any

measures: provide measure names separated by comma, min 1 max any

color.description: Solid hex string or palette array of hex colors

instructions: GridTable = AntV S2 wrapper (NOT Ant Design Table). Keep the VF SHORT — use helperFunctions.buildGridTableReport.
Requires ≥2 dimensions: first dim row, remaining dims column (needed for column headers + grand/sub totals).
1) Replace dimensions/measures with real result-column keys from data/SQL.
2) Pass formatStrings when Excel formats are provided. showTotals: true unless user disables.
3) Do not inline a full report/properties blob (it truncates under max_tokens). Never use <Table />.
